AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app manages a high-fidelity AI Music Studio, user libraries, and content discovery. Operational Patterns: - Always call 'strikeVibe' to initiate a new session before using 'warpMusic'. - Use 'openLibrary' and 'openHome' to switch between major app navigational sections. Constraints: - Playback commands like 'warpMusic' require an active generative session.
